reviewPolicy.passRequires: All 40 rows must bind to canonical Q1-Q40, responseKey/type and canonical part; every excerpt must be literal in the located passage; source/ledger/artifact hashes must match; and every key must have a substantive, independently reviewable rationale. A citation plus an assertion of correctness is insufficient.
reviewPolicy.notGivenRule: NOT GIVEN/NOT STATED outcomes require a rationale that identifies the missing proposition; a paragraph citation alone cannot establish absence from the passage.
reviewPolicy.approvalMeaning: PASS applies only to this Reading evidence gate. It is not a release, runtime-integration, or human-QA approval.
